items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: I knew Artie from demos and so forth

ctx.x: The School of Hard Knocks. Did you have any say in, “All right there’s a tenor sax solo, you know four bars here, I want Jerome Richardson.” Were you able to say that?

I would hire him. But I mean the thing was, for instance whatchacallit, baritone sax, Artie Kaplan, who did “Locomotion” and I knew Artie from demos and so forth, so if I had that commercial that had that kind of sound in it I would call Artie.
What would make a studio player not get called back?
